title: [Part 2] Describe a way/change that helps you save a lot of time
questions: And explain how you feel about the way/change
fullPromptText:
Describe a way/change that helps you save a lot of time.
You should say:
- What it is
- How you implement it
- How difficult it is
And explain how you feel about the way/change.

keyVocab: Pomodoro technique (phương pháp quả cà chua)
Streamline workflow (tối ưu hóa quy trình làm việc)
guide.suggestedIdeas: Mô tả một phương pháp cụ thể như lập To-do list buổi sáng, tắt thông báo điện thoại hoặc áp dụng Time-blocking.
guide.sampleOutline:
- Introduction: Adopting the Pomodoro Technique & notification blocker.
- Implementation: 25-min sprint, 5-min rest.
- Difficulty: Fighting the urge to check social media during initial days.
- Feelings: Liberating, remarkably enhanced personal efficiency.
